sn4.10:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn4.10:1.3: tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, bhikkhavoti. bhadanteti te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ. bhagavā etadavoca:
sn4.10:2.2: gamanīyo samparāyo, kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ.
sn4.10:2.4: yo bhikkhave ciraṃ jīvati, so vassasataṃ appaṃ vā bhiyyoti.
sn4.10:3.1: atha kho māro pāpimā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:
sn4.10:6.1: atha kho māro pāpimā jānāti maṃ bhagavā, jānāti maṃ sugatoti dukkhī dummano tatthevantaradhāyīti. āyuvaggo
